player_0.content: New plan: I prematurely declared "DONE" while in the Solarium, failing to explore the unvisited "north" direction which likely led to a new room. My previous strategy of moving back and forth between known rooms (Kitchen, Foyer, Mudroom, Solarium) without tracking visited states caused me to miss the final unexplored path. Next time, I will maintain a mental list of visited rooms and available directions. Before issuing "DONE", I will verify that every available direction from my current location has been tried or leads to a previously visited room. Specifically, when in the Solarium with "north" available, I will execute "GO: north" instead of stopping, ensuring all reachable rooms are visited.
